title: Ahead of the Heat
attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
handle_with_care: Health data about vulnerable adults — consent and data protection by design (UK GDPR), data minimisation and safeguarding throughout. The tool supports staff and carers; it never replaces professional judgement, and must fail safe.
licence_note: Sources not listed under 'mirrored' are NOT redistributed by us. Use the loader code in the repo to fetch them from the original publisher.

tables.name: alert_history
tables.description: Heat-health alert level by region and day. SYNTHETIC — generated with a realistic seasonal pattern, not the UKHSA feed. Switch to `ukhsa-alerts` once a fetcher exists.

columns.name: region
columns.description: One of the nine English regions UKHSA issues alerts for.

columns.name: alert_date
columns.description: Alert day, ISO-8601.

columns.name: alert_level
columns.description: Green, Yellow, Amber or Red.

columns.name: in_alert_season
columns.description: True 1 Jun – 30 Sep, the core heat alerting season in England. Outside it the level is always Green — absence of an alert is not evidence of low risk.

columns.name: consecutive_days_at_level
columns.description: Run length at the current level. Sustained heat matters more than a single hot day, and a single-row read misses that entirely.

columns.name: issued_at
columns.description: Issue timestamp, ISO-8601.

tables.name: synthetic_cohort
tables.description: Synthetic cohort with risk factors and care setting. No real person is described. Health-adjacent, so k >= 10 rather than the default 5.

columns.name: person_id
columns.description: Synthetic identifier. Not a real person.

columns.name: age_band
columns.description: 65-69 through 85+. Quasi-identifier.

columns.name: region
columns.description: English region. Quasi-identifier.

columns.name: care_setting
columns.description: Own home, Sheltered housing, Residential care or Nursing care. Quasi-identifier.

columns.name: mobility
columns.description: Independent through Immobile.

columns.name: lives_alone
columns.description: Living alone — a major heat-risk factor because nobody notices deterioration.

columns.name: has_cardiovascular
columns.description: Cardiovascular condition recorded.

columns.name: has_respiratory
columns.description: Respiratory condition recorded.

columns.name: on_diuretics
columns.description: On diuretics — raises dehydration risk in heat.

columns.name: cognitive_impairment
columns.description: Cognitive impairment recorded — affects ability to self-manage in heat.

columns.name: prior_heat_admission
columns.description: Previous heat-related admission.

columns.name: care_visits_per_week
columns.description: Scheduled care visits per week.

columns.name: predicted_risk
columns.description: Model score, 0–1. DELIBERATELY MISCALIBRATED — it ranks correctly but is roughly 2.7x too high in absolute terms. In a heat-health setting the absolute number is what triggers a visit, so ranking well is not enough. This is the point of the challenge notebook, not a defect.

columns.name: risk_band
columns.description: Low, Medium or High, derived from predicted_risk.

columns.name: heat_event_last_summer
columns.description: Ground truth: whether a heat-related event occurred. Compare against predicted_risk to see the calibration gap.

tables.name: region_weather_daily
tables.description: Daily temperature and humidity by area. SYNTHETIC — `metoffice` is pointer-only after the D4 licence review, so nothing here is an observation. Do not report a temperature finding from this as if it were measured.

columns.name: area
columns.description: County-level area. FINER than the regional grain of alert_history — joining the two is a real join, not a rename.

columns.name: observation_date
columns.description: Observation day, ISO-8601.

columns.name: temp_max_c
columns.description: Daily maximum temperature, Celsius.

columns.name: temp_min_c
columns.description: Daily minimum temperature, Celsius. Overnight minima matter — heat risk is driven by nights that do not cool.

columns.name: relative_humidity_pct
columns.description: Relative humidity, percent.

columns.name: heat_index_c
columns.description: Apparent temperature combining heat and humidity. Diverges from temp_max_c only when both are high.

columns.name: is_synthetic
columns.description: Always true. Present so the caveat survives a join, a filter and an export into someone's slide.

usage.duckdb: INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs; SELECT * FROM read_parquet('https://data.inno-forum.co.uk/c05-ahead-of-the-heat/v1/gold/<table>.parquet');
usage.note: No credentials. No account. Anonymous HTTPS.
